still_open: MK-PF-F-038: Both readers must use the same decided first available price, coverage sentence and nonannualized total.
MK-PF-F-039: When there is no prior close, use first valid close and actual covered dates; never claim full window coverage.
MK-PF-F-040: For morning purchases include the paid amount in that day's base and all resulting shares in the evening value, using prior evening mark. Refuse missing movement dates.
MK-PF-F-042: An explicit total including null wins; without one require declared rate basis and known duration. A known within-year total may be used unchanged.
MK-PF-F-043: Require periodTotal or row duration and rate basis; compound a stated 2Y yearly rate or refuse absent metadata.
MK-PF-F-044: Use authentic start weights for the shared window and include total-loss holdings; otherwise expose a restricted synthetic calculation and refuse unsupported rows.
MK-ST-F-081: Require known consistent membership; refuse unexplained negative net values rather than clamp. Preserve finite positive inputs, or make monetary quantization an explicit settled rule.

MK-ST-F-082: Normalize broker sign at the ingest boundary (or refuse ambiguity), enforce positive magnitudes and finite values, preserve invalid/missing-date markers and missing income amounts. Internal transfers net to zero.
